text: Here, I am enveloped in a blend of curiosity and anticipation. The first scene, with people gathered in discussion or learning, reflects a collective pursuit of knowledge—an environment vibrating with potential yet softened by the calmness of communal focus. Passing into the exhibit space in the second scene, vivid colors and bold text awaken my sense of wonder. The display of research and development stimulates reflection on progress and our relationship with technology. I feel simultaneously small in the face of so much shared inquiry, yet empowered—reminded that even in a vast world of ideas, my presence and questions matter.
